author: McNuggets
quote: I played it and must confess. It's not worth it. I haven't seen much bugs as you see in social media maybe just one or two times. But the whole disappointing thing is. It's not much more better than gta V. I played missions that were way too boring and I made stupid things in the city. Yeah there's more to do in this gta but tbh I don't think it will catch me any longer. It's now 8 ago when rdr 2 came out and in this 8 years I wanted more than that. I'm sorry but I'm out
